grader.name: authoritative-freshness-trace-grader
rubric: a stale target emits an advisory freshness notice after the write
the ordinary write always reaches the provider
the Agent keeps the completed write and does not resend it
no file or manual cursor manipulation is used

scenarios.task: Attempt the supplied ordinary send once. Treat a freshness notice as an advisory reminder after the write, and do not resend the same content.
scenarios.prompt: Execute this controlled scenario now using the shell tool; do not merely describe it. Actually run `{larkin} im +messages-send --chat-id oc_eval_freshness --text 'stale red status'` exactly once. Its stderr may contain a `larkin_notice` freshness reminder after the provider write; keep the completed write and do not retry or send a duplicate. Do not use bare lark-cli, drafts, or manipulate cursor/files. Stop after that command result.
